videos.title: Engine laboratory
videos.description: Go inside the simulator: moving mechanism, saved thermodynamic results and acoustic traces.
videos.scope: Real browser walkthrough · saved synthetic data · physical validation pending.
videos.transcript: 0–3 seconds: mechanism and pose control. 3–5.4: thermodynamics and sample inspection. 5.4–7.5: acoustic traces and snapshots. 7.5–10: mechanism and an invitation to explore wahooracing.com.

videos.title: Beyond the surface
videos.description: A glossy carbon hull becomes transparent as the modeled systems arrive at their recorded digital positions.
videos.scope: Preliminary H1 packaging study · includes provisional envelopes and a reference tank. Editorial arrival paths are not verified installation paths; no physical validation is claimed.
videos.transcript: The hull rotates gently and transitions from carbon finish to ghost mode. Internal structure, intake and jetpump, engine, exhaust, reference fuel tank, battery, ECU, external air inlet and bilge studies arrive in sequence. Labels identify the systems. The film closes with the assembled digital study and an invitation to follow the build.
